mapper.select: SELECT i.invitation_token , i.household_id , h.name AS household_name , i.inviter_user_id , u.display_name AS inviter_name , i.invited_email , i.status , i.expires_at , i.accepted_user_id , ua.display_name AS accepted_user_name , i.created_at FROM t_household_invitation i INNER JOIN m_household h ON i.household_id = h.household_id INNER JOIN m_user u ON i.inviter_user_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN m_user ua ON i.accepted_user_id = ua.user_id WHERE i.invitation_token = #{token}

SELECT i.invitation_token , i.household_id , h.name AS household_name , i.inviter_user_id , u.display_name AS inviter_name , i.invited_email , i.status , i.expires_at , i.accepted_user_id , ua.display_name AS accepted_user_name , i.created_at FROM t_household_invitation i INNER JOIN m_household h ON i.household_id = h.household_id INNER JOIN m_user u ON i.inviter_user_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN m_user ua ON i.accepted_user_id = ua.user_id WHERE i.household_id = #{householdId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
